conditions: The language proposition applies within the exact publisher document and revision.
limitations: The condition determines candidate name bindings. It does not guarantee successful evaluation of a variable before it is assigned, and it excludes special names and namespace field-access names.

statement: The pinned BQN core draft allows an ordinary identifier use to consider a same-name definition in an enclosing scope without requiring that definition to precede the use in program order. A distinct same-name potential definition in the same scope must precede the use in program order.
